plan_approval.title: Ask me to approve plans
plan_approval.description: Before any file changes, show the plan and wait for your approval.

conflict_approval.title: Ask me when research disagrees
conflict_approval.description: When investigations find conflicting answers, let you choose which to trust. Otherwise conflicts are reported in the result.

reviewer_default.title: Add a review step by default
reviewer_default.description: After checks pass, the agent reviews the change against the plan before it is marked done.

max_repair_rounds.title: Repair attempts
max_repair_rounds.description: How many times the agent may fix failing checks before stopping for your review.

max_review_rounds.title: Review rounds
max_review_rounds.description: How many review passes are allowed when a reviewer requests changes.

max_jobs.title: Steps per workflow
max_jobs.description: Upper limit on agent jobs in one workflow, so a run can never grow without bound.

max_investigations.title: Research questions
max_investigations.description: Most independent questions one research workflow may investigate.

max_parallel_reads.title: Parallel investigations
max_parallel_reads.description: How many read-only investigations may be open at the same time.

keep_finished_days.title: Keep finished runs (days)
keep_finished_days.description: Remove the saved step history of finished runs after this many days. 0 keeps them forever.
